summary: The Dataset Chart tab now shows every series in grey and lets you focus up to four in colour, picked from a triangle map beside the chart.
details: Plot origin curves or one age across origins, as values, incremental values, or age-to-age factors.
The triangle map fits any triangle size; hover it for a close-up, click an origin, age, or cell, or drag a box to zoom.
One readout lists the focused series and the range of the rest at the pointer.
Drag the strip under the chart to zoom into a range of ages or origins.
